主要内容: On June 29, 2018, Core Laboratories N.V. (NYSE: "CLB US") revised its second quarter 2018 revenue guidance to $174,000,000 to $175,000,000, projecting an EPS of $0.57 to $0.59, exceeding both sequential and year-over-year results. The revisions were due to delays in international field development activity impacting revenue opportunities for its Reservoir Description segment, which derives over 85% of its revenue from international projects. The delays primarily affect the North Sea, Middle East, Asia-Pacific, Gulf of Mexico, and other deepwater regions. The revised guidance also includes ramp-up costs for new laboratory technology and infrastructure, such as client-driven labs in Qatar, Indonesia, and Alaska. Core Laboratories N.V. issued third quarter 2018 guidance, projecting revenue of approximately $177,000,000 to $179,000,000, with expected EPS ranging from $0.64 to $0.66. Operating margins are expected to exceed 20%. The guidance excludes foreign exchange gains or losses and assumes an effective tax rate of 15%.
